component.name: Karasu
component.summary: Anime and manga tracker for AniList

description.p: Karasu keeps your AniList list in step with what you actually watch and read. It notices the episode playing in mpv, VLC or a browser tab, or on your Jellyfin server, and updates your progress once you have watched enough of it — with a countdown you can see, skip or cancel.

The rest of AniList is here too: your lists with filters and bulk edits, the season calendar, statistics and a year in review, your local library matched against your list, notifications, the social feed and the forum. Everything talks to AniList directly; there is no server in between.
